LESSON: SELF- SPEAKING 1/

Grade: PP2
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.2: Self- SPEAKING 1/

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Self- SPEAKING 1/
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What do you do when (1 1/2HRS) thoughts freely. you need something?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. practise Self- SPEAKING 1/
2. use Self- SPEAKING 1/ in clear sentences

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Self- SPEAKING 1/

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Self- SPEAKING 1/

Teach
• Focus skill: Self- SPEAKING 1/.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Self- SPEAKING 1/.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Self- SPEAKING 1/
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What do you do when (1 1/2HRS) thoughts freely. you need something?
2. What can you say about school. needs. yourself?
3. when they express their needs and 3. What do you do when to express their needs and ideas. someone wrongs you?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
